title: pomaria parviflora
intro: Pomaria parviflora, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its vibrant yellow and orange flowers, which bloom in the winter months, providing a burst of color in the desert landscape. The health benefits of Desert Marigold include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, while its therapeutic actions are believed to aid in reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Pomaria parviflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
